title: He copied a woodpecker (Hans Tikkanen and the Woodpecker Method) x Chessigma Supercoach
post: He copied a woodpecker and became a grandmaster. How many puzzles did you solve today? #ad #chessigma #chess #woodpeckermethod #chesstok #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: He became a grandmaster by copying a woodpecker.
phrases.say: [amused] He became a grandmaster... by copying a woodpecker.

phrases.text: Three grandmaster norms in seven weeks. And wait till you hear his name.
phrases.say: Three grandmaster norms... in seven weeks. [mischievously] And wait till you hear his name.

phrases.text: A woodpecker can hit the same tree 12,000 times a day. He did the same thing with chess puzzles.
phrases.say: A woodpecker can hit the same tree... twelve thousand times a day. [curious] He did the same thing... with chess puzzles.

phrases.text: Sweden, 2010. Hans Tikkanen is twenty-five, and still not a grandmaster.
phrases.say: Sweden, twenty ten. Hans Tikkanen is twenty-five... and still not a grandmaster.

phrases.text: His plan sounds too simple. Over a thousand puzzles. Solve them all. Then solve the same ones again, in half the time.
phrases.say: His plan sounds... too simple. Over a thousand puzzles. Solve them all. [dramatic] Then solve the same ones again... in half the time.

phrases.text: Four weeks. Then two. Then one. Then days, until the whole set takes one single day.
phrases.say: Four weeks. Then two. Then one. Then days... until the whole set takes... one single day.

phrases.text: By then, he isn't calculating anymore. He just sees it.
phrases.say: [impressed] By then, he isn't calculating anymore. He just... sees it.

phrases.text: That year, Hans Tikkanen becomes a grandmaster.
phrases.say: [excited] That year, Hans Tikkanen becomes a grandmaster!

phrases.text: Then champion of Sweden. Five times.
phrases.say: Then champion of Sweden. [proud] Five times.

phrases.text: And his name? In Finnish, Tikkanen means little woodpecker.
phrases.say: [amused] And his name? In Finnish, Tikkanen means... little woodpecker.

phrases.text: That's why it's called the Woodpecker Method.
phrases.say: That's why it's called... the Woodpecker Method.

phrases.text: Today, you don't need a thousand printed puzzles. Chessigma's Supercoach runs the Woodpecker Method for you.
phrases.say: Today, you don't need a thousand printed puzzles. Chess-Sigma's Supercoach runs the Woodpecker Method for you.

phrases.text: Pick a set at your level. It times every cycle, and only lets you move on when you're faster and cleaner.
phrases.say: Pick a set at your level. It times every cycle... and only lets you move on when you're faster... and cleaner.

phrases.text: Then the coach reads your own games, finds the mistakes you keep making, and builds your training plan every morning.
phrases.say: Then the coach reads your own games, finds the mistakes you keep making... and builds your training plan, every morning.

phrases.text: So, how many puzzles did you solve today?
phrases.say: [curious] So... how many puzzles did you solve today?
